page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.6xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture using an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. It features 24 dedicated virtual CPUs mapped across 12 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled. Memory capacity is provisioned at 48.0 GB, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 2.0 GB per vCPU. The instance includes 35 MB of L3 cache and supports instruction sets such as AVX-512 VNNI, AES, and FMA. It does not include local storage or discrete GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached block storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a performance profile centered around multi-core scaling. Single-threaded benchmarks, including single-core stress-ng CPU tests and single-threaded gzip compression, perform in the lower range. Multi-core execution demonstrates solid mid-tier output, evidenced by a multi-core stress-ng score of 21007.3 and a Geekbench multi-core rating of 8967.0. Memory throughput reaches 108.94 GB/sec for uncached reads and 47.99 GB/sec for writes. The hardware profile offers predictable compute density for multi-threaded workloads without requiring large memory overheads, making it resource-efficient for CPU-bound tasks.

Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM balance and multi-threaded efficiency, ecs.c6.6xlarge is suited for compute-heavy parallel applications. Typical deployment scenarios include software compilation, image processing pipelines, static web serving with up to 15.86 GB/sec throughput, in-memory key-value processing like Redis reaching 20.09 million SET operations per second, and distributed application workers.
